note.title: Future time
note.overview: This lesson contains 50 enabled questions. It teaches Future time through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
learningGoals: Recall the core language for Future time.
Identify the task direction before writing.
Explain errors by naming the article, subject, tense, auxiliary, agreement or negative rule.
Use the material in a short controlled sentence.
mustMemoriseRules: Core production target: futur proche = aller in the present + infinitive.
Only aller is conjugated; the action verb stays infinitive.
Use a future time phrase to make the frame clear.
Negatives wrap around aller: je ne vais pas + infinitive.
Simple-future items in this section are recognition/light exposure.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the taught French example meaning « I am going to watch a film. ».
workedExamples.why: Pattern: je vais + infinitive. The example places every grammar word in its taught position.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the taught French example meaning « You are going to play tennis. ».
workedExamples.why: Pattern: tu vas + infinitive. The example places every grammar word in its taught position.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the taught French example meaning « She is going to buy a pizza. ».
workedExamples.why: Pattern: il / elle va + infinitive. The example places every grammar word in its taught position.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the taught French example meaning « We are going to go out in town. ».
workedExamples.why: Pattern: nous allons + infinitive. The example places every grammar word in its taught position.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the taught French example meaning « You are going to finish your homework. ».
workedExamples.why: Pattern: vous allez + infinitive. The example places every grammar word in its taught position.

commonMistakes: Using a future phrase with a completed-past verb.
Treating extension simple future as the core target.
A small article or ending can change the grammar even when the main vocabulary is recognisable.
Do not guess from one familiar word; answer the complete tested chunk.
Do not translate the whole line in this task; enter only the word replacing the blank.
